# Model registry

```{r registry}

# MODEL REGISTRY ###############################################################

cg_dir <- "dynamic_validation/callgraph_csv/Callgraphs"
xm_dir <- "dynamic_validation/extra_models_csv"

model_registry <- data.table(
  model  = c("ORCHIDEE", "PCR-GLOBWB", "HYPE", "MHM", "SWAT"),
  format = c("two_file", "two_file", "combined", "combined", "combined"),
  static = c(file.path(cg_dir, "13_ORCHIDEE-MAN-2025_ORIGINAL", "callgraph_edges.csv"),
             file.path(cg_dir, "14_PCR-GLOBWB_model", "callgraph_edges.csv"),
             file.path(xm_dir, "HYPE"),
             file.path(xm_dir, "mHM"),
             file.path(xm_dir, "SWATplus")),
  runtime = c(file.path(cg_dir, "13_ORCHIDEE-MAN-2025-AND IOIPSL", "runtime_callgraph_edges.csv"),
              file.path(cg_dir, "14_PCR-GLOBWB_model", "runtime_callgraph_edges.csv"),
              file.path(xm_dir, "HYPE"),
              file.path(xm_dir, "mHM"),
              file.path(xm_dir, "SWATplus")),
  cc = c("ORCHIDEE", "PCR-GLOBWB", "HYPE", "MHM", "SWAT")
)
```

# Static risk scores and runtime join

```{r build_join}

# BUILD P_k AND JOIN RUNTIME E_k ###############################################

joined <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(model_registry)), function(i) {
  ed <- load_edges_fun(model_registry$static[i], model_registry$runtime[i],
                       model_registry$format[i])
  jn <- join_runtime_fun(build_static_fun(ed$el, model_registry$cc[i]), ed$rt)
  jn[, model := model_registry$model[i]]
})
names(joined) <- model_registry$model
```

# Rank correlation between $P_k$ and runtime intensity

```{r rank_correlation}

# SPEARMAN P_k VS E_k WITH BOOTSTRAP CI ########################################

corr_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(joined, function(dt) {
  ex <- dt[any_exercised == TRUE & !is.na(P_k_q50)]
  bo <- boot(ex, function(d, i)
    suppressWarnings(cor(d$P_k_q50[i], d$Ek_sum[i], method = "spearman")), R = 1000)
  ci <- boot.ci(bo, type = "perc")$percent[1, c(4, 5)]
  data.table(model = dt$model[1], n_exercised = nrow(ex),
             spearman = bo$t0, ci_lo = ci[1], ci_hi = ci[2])
}))

corr_dt
```

# Matched-frequency contrast

```{r matched_contrast}

# HIGH VS LOW P_k PATHS MATCHED ON E_k, HOPS AND SIZE ##########################

matched_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(joined, function(dt) {
  dt  <- dt[!is.na(P_k_q50)]
  qhi <- quantile(dt$P_k_q50, 0.90); qlo <- quantile(dt$P_k_q50, 0.10)
  cvm <- median(dt$CV_k, na.rm = TRUE)
  dm  <- dt[any_exercised == TRUE]
  dm[, grp := fifelse(P_k_q50 >= qhi & CV_k < cvm, 1L,
              fifelse(P_k_q50 <= qlo, 0L, NA_integer_))]
  dm  <- dm[!is.na(grp)]
  dm[, stmt := pm_cc * hops]
  mo  <- matchit(grp ~ Ek_sum + hops + stmt, data = dm, method = "nearest",
                 distance = "mahalanobis", replace = TRUE)
  md  <- match.data(mo)
  rbindlist(lapply(c("pm_cc", "pm_indeg", "pm_btw"), function(mt) {
    a <- md[[mt]][md$grp == 1]; b <- md[[mt]][md$grp == 0]
    data.table(model = dt$model[1], metric = mt, n_pairs = sum(md$grp == 1),
               A = effsize::VD.A(a, b)$estimate,
               wilcox_p = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value))
  }))
}))

dcast(matched_dt, model + n_pairs ~ metric, value.var = "A")
```

# Complexity on rarely exercised paths

```{r reverse_predictive}

# HIGH VS LOW P_k WITHIN THE RUNTIME-HEAVY DECILE ##############################

reverse_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(joined, function(dt) {
  ex  <- dt[any_exercised == TRUE & !is.na(P_k_q50)]
  hot <- ex[Ek_sum >= quantile(Ek_sum, 0.90)]
  hot[, st := ifelse(P_k_q50 >= median(P_k_q50), "hi", "lo")]
  a <- hot[st == "hi", pm_cc]; b <- hot[st == "lo", pm_cc]
  data.table(model = dt$model[1], n = nrow(hot),
             A_cc = effsize::VD.A(a, b)$estimate,
             wilcox_p = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value))
}))

reverse_dt
```
